title: Molfar Defence Technologies — modular radar systems

title: Nanordica Medical — antibacterial wound care
summary: Tallinn-based Nanordica sells nanotech antibacterial wound-care products. Consumable medtech with reimbursement-driven market entry per country.

title: Naratix — e-commerce product data automation
summary: Bucharest-based Naratix automates product data enrichment and localization for e-commerce. Every webshop entering a new language market needs this — inherently cross-border model.
notes: GPSR product-information duties (in force) add a compliance angle to product data quality.

title: Nexcade — AI agents for freight forwarding workflows
summary: London-based Nexcade automates freight-forwarder back office with AI agents. Same thesis funded in Kyiv (Cargofy) the month before — freight ops automation is racing across markets; CZ/SK forwarders are unserved.
notes: eFTI regulation (electronic freight transport information, application 2027) digitizes freight documents EU-wide — tailwind for both.

title: Nordic Forestry Automation — operator-support AI for forestry machinery
money_note: €4.3M (SEK 48M), early Aug 2026 (Navigare, Almi Invest Greentech, LRF Ventures, Sveaskog, Södra)

title: Nopan — payment optimization fintech
summary: Amsterdam-based Nopan optimizes payment routing/costs for merchants. Payment-cost transparency pressure and interchange complexity are pan-European.

title: Oktogrid — monitoring for electricity transformers
summary: Copenhagen-based Oktogrid retrofits monitoring onto distribution transformers. European DSOs face grid-congestion and asset-aging pressure — hardware+SaaS model transfers to ČEZ/EG.D territory.
notes: Grid investment supercycle (EU Action Plan for Grids) is the macro driver.

title: Ossprey Security — software supply chain security
summary: London-based Ossprey secures software supply chains against build-time attacks. CRA obligations (main duties Dec 2027, vulnerability reporting from Sept 2026) turn SBOM/supply-chain security into mandated spend.
notes: CRA reporting obligations start 11 Sep 2026 — under a month after reference date.

title: Passionfroot — B2B creator marketing marketplace
summary: Berlin-based Passionfroot matches B2B brands with creators and automates campaign ops. Creator-economy infrastructure maturing into B2B budgets.

title: Paymove — QR-code payment infrastructure for offline commerce
money_note: €2.1M seed, June 2026 (Kogito Ventures, 4growth VC); expansion to Western Europe planned

title: Paypercut — payment orchestration for CEE merchants
summary: Sofia-based Paypercut aggregates payment methods for CEE merchants in one integration. Payment orchestration is proven in Western Europe; CEE localization (local schemes, BLIK-type methods) is the moat.

title: PDKINEMATICS — GPS-independent navigation for drones
money_note: €2M seed, June 2026 (Coinvest Capital, Iron Wolf Capital)
summary: Vilnius-based PDKINEMATICS builds GPS-denied navigation for drones. Defence-driven demand across the Baltic/NATO flank.

title: Pixel-Flo — scalable microLED display manufacturing
summary: Sheffield-based Pixel-Flo develops manufacturing technology for microLED displays. Niche deeptech.

title: Project Q — open-source defence and security systems integration
summary: Berlin-based Project Q builds open-source software integrating defence and security systems. European defence-software interoperability play.

title: Prolo — AI procurement for construction firms

title: Scape — AI-native email client automating inbox operations
summary: Stockholm-based Scape automates replies and inbox management with AI. Crowded horizontal category.

title: Sloneek — HR information system for SMEs
money_note: $6M Series A (~€5.2M), June 2026 (Orbit Capital, Venture to Future Fund)

notes: Every employer is touched by JMHZ + pay transparency (June 2026); HRIS vendors are the delivery channel for compliance.

title: Supaso — recycled-paper insulation packaging, machine-as-a-service
money_note: Undisclosed round (~10% equity to Gerald Jeitler GmbH, RLB Steiermark, FMMS), announced 3 Aug 2026

notes: 300 B2B customers in 10 countries; machine-as-a-service model transfers without logistics cost of shipping bulky packaging.

title: Superpal — AI coworker for Slack task automation
summary: Vilnius-based Superpal automates task capture and follow-ups inside Slack. Early-stage horizontal AI assistant.

title: Sybilla Technologies — space situational awareness sensor networks

title: TaiSan — lightweight sodium-ion batteries

title: Wultra — post-quantum authentication for banks
money_note: €6.8M Series A, June 2026 (Seventure, J&T Ventures, Elevator Ventures)
